description: IRVE TERRITOIRE D’ÉNERGIE 90 Territoire de Belfort is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Guillaume Faltot. Identification and referencing of charging stations installed by Citeos Besançon for the Territory of Energy 90 (formerly SIAGEP). Coverage: Guillaume Faltot. The portal shows the English title as "ENERGY TERRITORY IREVA 90 Territory of Belfort" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Guillaume Faltot. Its keywords include territoire-de-belfort, irve, borne-electrique, borne-de-recharge. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2023-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
